sentences.text:
Coram : Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S.N. Pathak
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. A.K. Sahani, Advocate For the State : Mr. Abhilash Kumar, Ac to Gp-Iii
------
8/ 11.10.2023

It is specific contention of learned counsel for the petitioner that though in compliance of order dated 24.7.2019 passed in W.P.(C) No. 7031 of 2016, an order has been passed by the Land Acquisition Officer , but the same is not as per the requirement of Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The requirement under Section 18 of the said Act is that the Land Acquisition Officer shall refer the matter to the Land Acquisition Judge on objection of the petitioner regarding measurement and compensation.
Learned counsel submits that instead of referring the matter, the Land Acquisition Officer has decided the same, which is illegal and arbitrary.
Put up this case on 23.11.2023 for further hearing.

(Dr. S. N. Pathak, J.) R.Kr.
